_comment: Hand-curated facts the ANRE tariff pages don't print. Keyed by ANRE decision number. effective_from = date the price applies (from legis.md / Monitorul Oficial), not the decision date.

222/2026.note: In force from publication in Monitorul Oficial; repeals 459/2025.

notes.electricity: Prices in MDL/kWh excl. VAT (source: bani/kWh). Household (universal service, low voltage) tariff per supplier: premier_energy = center/south, fee_nord = north. flat is the default; day 07-23 / night 23-07 only with hourly metering. Not yet confirmed whether these include distribution.
notes.gas: Prices in MDL/m3 excl. VAT (source: lei/1000 m3). Household price = Energocom public-service-obligation price at low-pressure distribution exit.
notes.water: Unit presumed MDL/m3; ANRE page states neither unit nor VAT nor effective date. Household tariffs only. technical_water = non-potable supply in towns without a drinking-water tariff.
